main.description: Record the physical handoff of a surplus lot from donor to matched receiver. Audit event that closes the redistribution path. Per ADR-2605211241. On success: lot state matched -> redistributed. Both donor PDS and receiver PDS emit symmetric warehouse.pick / warehouse.putaway records when both are Adherent SBT holders. Cross-border physical movement should also reference a freeportRegistry.recordFreeportEntry entry via bondedEntryRef (optional).

matchUri.description: AT URI of the prior matchDemand event.

carrierDid.description: Optional DID of the logistics carrier.

valueAttestedUsdcMicros.description: Final attested value at handoff. Should be consistent with registerSurplusLot.estimatedValueUsdcMicros unless valuationAttestationUri overrides.

tithePaymentRef.description: Optional AT URI of the com.etzhayyim.apps.payment.sent record that carried the 10% in-kind tithe coupling for this lot. Per ADR-2605192130.

bondedEntryRef.description: Optional AT URI of com.etzhayyim.apps.freeportRegistry.recordFreeportEntry for cross-border bonded transit.

ftzZoneRef.description: Optional AT URI of com.etzhayyim.apps.ftzZones.recordZone for FTZ-mediated transit.

receiverAckSignature.description: Optional receiver's WebAuthn / DID signature over the handoff payload.

warehousePickRef.description: Auto-emitted com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.pick record on donor side, when applicable.

warehousePutawayRef.description: Auto-emitted com.etzhayyim.apps.warehouse.putaway record on receiver side, when applicable.
